# HexPiece 2.7.3

The dragon's rules and the new Transformed effect. Nothing here has been tested in game yet; the build's checks pass.

- **New effect: Transformed** (an azure dragon's eye in your effect list). It doubles your maximum health (your health doubles with
  it, so you keep the same share), and gives Resistance II with it. You have it:
  - while the Uo Uo no Mi's dragon is out, from the transformation to the way back;
  - while Nika's Gear 5 is on.
  When it ends your health is brought back within your normal maximum.
- **The dragon can only use its own moves:** while it is out (coming, out or going), R and Ctrl + R do nothing (you stay in fruit
  mode), and no Haki at all works (Armament, Observation, the Conqueror and its quick abilities, Ryou). The server refuses them too.
  Z works only in fruit mode, as before.
